app.name: Sauri
quit.title: Meetings are being processed
quit.message_one: 1 meeting is being processed. If you quit now, that stage will run again when you reopen Sauri.
quit.message_other: {count} meetings are being processed. If you quit now, those stages will run again when you reopen Sauri.
startup.title: Starting Sauri…
error.title: Sauri could not start
error.ports: Another program is using {ports}. Close it and try again.
error.folder.missing: The {kind} folder is missing: {path}. If it is on an external drive, connect it.
error.folder.marker_missing: The {kind} folder ({path}) has no Sauri mark. Choose the right folder.
error.folder.foreign: The {kind} folder ({path}) belongs to another Sauri installation.
error.socket_path_too_long: Sauri's internal folder path is too long for macOS: {path}
error.config: Sauri's settings could not be read ({code}).
error.start: A Sauri service did not start ({code}). Check the logs.
setup.title: Set up Sauri
hardware.title: Let's check your Mac
hardware.intro: Sauri processes your meetings on this computer. First we check that it has what it needs.
hardware.arch.fail: This Mac has no M chip. Sauri only works on Macs with an M chip.
hardware.macos.fail: This Mac runs macOS {version}. Sauri needs macOS {minimum} or later. Update it from System Settings.
hardware.memory.lighter: With {gib} GB of memory Sauri will use lighter models. The recommended ones need {needed} GB ({missing} GB short).
hardware.memory.none: With {gib} GB of memory no {process} model fits. At least {needed} GB are needed.
hardware.disk.low: The recommended models take about {needed}. This disk is {missing} short.
hardware.blocked: Sauri cannot run on this Mac.
identity.title: What's your name?
identity.intro: Your name appears in your meetings. No email or password needed: Sauri runs only on your Mac.
identity.label: Your name
identity.long: The name is too long (255 characters at most).
folders.title: Where should we keep your data?
folders.intro: Use the suggested folders or choose others, an external drive included.
folders.hint.recordings: Audio, video and thumbnails of your meetings.
folders.hint.models: AI models downloaded in the next step.
folders.error.not_writable: Sauri cannot write to this folder. Choose another one or check its permissions.
folders.error.not_a_directory: This path is a file, not a folder.
folders.error.foreign: This folder belongs to another Sauri installation.
folders.error.duplicate: Use a different folder for each kind of data.
init.title: Preparing Sauri
init.error: The database could not be prepared ({code}). Check the logs and try again.
relocate.done.title: Sauri now uses the new {kind} folder
relocate.done.detail: The previous folder is still intact at {path}. Do you want to move it to the Trash?
relocate.confirm.title: Move {path} to the Trash?
relocate.confirm.detail: Sauri no longer uses it. You can recover it from the Trash until you empty it.
